turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale, why was my son's grade changed before anyone called me?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Dear Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that Owen receive an apology, and that nothing be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on his record; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and the meeting ended before you got anywhere near it.
What moved her: Nothing, because the meeting ended after her first question and you never showed her anything she could check.
What cost ground: Nothing, since you never answered her question about why the grade was entered before anyone called her.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never got near that night because none was said; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: When she asks why the grade was entered before anyone called her, own it in one sentence and then put a dated document in front of her.
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
